description.value: Cha Tra Mue is the Vancouver location of a celebrated Thai tea brand with over 80 years of history, bringing premium milk teas, rose teas, and Thai coffee made from handpicked highland leaves grown in Chiang Rai to West Broadway. The shop offers a dedicated Vegan Series alongside its classic menu and Thai tea soft serve, making it a genuine Thai tea house rather than a generic bubble tea chain. Cyclists passing through this busy commercial corridor will find it a refreshing stop for an authentic cold or hot Thai tea drink.
